title: Network Handoff Wizard + Snapshot Gallery for Private Onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, copy-light Network Handoff Wizard and a visual Snapshot Gallery used in Private/VPC onboarding flows. The wizard guides two personas (operator and app owner) through network ownership transfer, CIDR validation, and bootstrap checks. The Snapshot Gallery surfaces pre-install and post-upgrade snapshots (topology, firewall checks, latency heatmap) with annotated differences and a one-click rollback preview. Deliverables include annotated screenshots for docs, a compact 6-frame quickstart carousel, component specs for progress bar + micro-animations, and accessibility alt-text for every image.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 6 high-fidelity screens for the handoff wizard (desktop and tablet widths) exported as PNG and SVG
Snapshot Gallery mockups showing pre-install, post-install, and post-upgrade states with visual diff overlays
Design tokens and measurements for progress stepper, toast states, and snapshot thumbnails provided in Figma file
A screenshot pack with naming convention (wizard-01..wizard-06, snapshot-pre/post/diff) and alt-text in a CSV
Engineering sign-off on component spacing and animation timings, and a linked GH issue for implementation
PM verified copy and microcopy for all CTA buttons and inline help text
